messages:
ana: Heads-up: EdgeWave SI confirmed they're ready to start an HSM/KMS connector pilot with Redwood Private next week. Need quick go/no-go checklist.

sam: Core checklist: SAML SSO for SI portal, SCIM provisioning (groups mapping), KMS integration (PKCS#11 + envelope), secrets rotation, export/import policy, VPC peering & firewall rules, audit webhook delivery.

jia: I can own the runbook and automation. Need test credentials and the EdgeWave PKCS#11 binary. Also a minimal connector YAML to validate mTLS and client certs.

mike: Comms note: timeline? If pilot succeeds, marketing wants a joint announcement + marketplace tile. Earliest launch window ~ 3 weeks after pilot completion.

ana: Partner prefers testing true HSM path but can supply a software KMS fallback for initial runs. They also offered SOC2 artifacts.

sam: For security gating: no raw key material logged, HSM operations flagged in telemetry, audit events delivered to audit API v2. Also need a short threat-model signoff.

jia: Draft smoke tests:
- SCIM: create user -> verify group `redwood-admins` mapping
- SAML: login -> assert attribute `redwood_tier=partner`
- PKCS#11: load module, import a test key, run `pkcs11-tool --sign` (sanity)
- KMS: envelope encrypt/decrypt roundtrip via `/v1/kms/encrypt` endpoint
- Rotation: rotate key -> ensure old tokens are rejected
- Audit: confirm events appear in `audit-events` stream (schema v2)

mike: Marketing items: co-branded one-pager, logo approval flow, short FAQ explaining network requirements (VPC peering, IP allowlist) and HSM vs software KMS differences.

sam: I'll loop in Legal and Security. @legal please review the joint messaging template and the embargo window. Also tagging infra to validate VPC peer steps.

deploy-bot: Reminder: pilot deploy window reserved 2026-04-08 02:00-04:00 UTC. Please confirm by EOD.

ana: Our pilot gating list: 1) network tunnel & egress checklist validated, 2) SOC2/ISO artifacts received and checked, 3) PKCS#11 passes CI smoke tests.

jia: Estimate: runbook + automated smoke tests ready in 72 hours once we get the pkcs11 tarball and test creds. Ill post the connector YAML in the runbook.

mike: If runbook done and partner artifacts clear, Ill draft the embargoed announcement and schedule a marketplace submission slot three weeks after pilot sign-off.

ana: Action owners: Sam (security questionnaire & legal loop), Jia (runbook + automation), Mike (comms + logo approvals), Ana (coordinate pilot dates with EdgeWave). Ping me if you need help. :thumbsup:
